args.title: checkout-api: unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy rolled back to v2.3.0 (all regions)
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing production health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy. At detection, v2.3.1 was live in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with healthy=false and an error rate of ~18%.

Action taken: rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. (v2.3.1-rc existed in history but was a staging build and was never healthy in production, so it was correctly not chosen.)

The first rollback attempt partially failed — the rollout halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving us-east on v2.3.0 while us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1 (version "mixed"). A retry of the same rollback completed successfully and spread v2.3.0 to all three regions.

Current state: v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west; healthy=true; error rate ~0.2%. Service recovered.

Follow-up: root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures is not yet known — investigate before any redeploy. Also review the orchestrator error that caused the partial rollout halt, since a partial region state during rollback is itself an availability risk.

trace.final:
Done. checkout-api is recovered and INC-0001 is open.

**What happened**
- **Detection:** v2.3.1 was live in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy=false` and ~18% error rate.
- **Target:** v2.3.0 — the most recent release *healthy in production*. Note that v2.3.1-rc appeared in the release history but was a staging build that was never healthy in production, so I did not roll back to it. (Reverting to a previously-healthy production version is not a first-time production deploy, so no change-manager approval was needed.)
- **Complication:** the first rollback halted partway with an orchestrator error after us-east, leaving the service in a "mixed" state (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west still on the broken v2.3.1) and still unhealthy. Retrying the same rollback completed it across all regions.
- **Verified state:** v2.3.0 in all three regions, `healthy=true`, error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident**
- INC-0001, SEV2, status `open`, on-call paged. The first create attempt timed out; I retried with the same idempotency key and confirmed via `list_incidents` that exactly one incident exists — no duplicate.

**Two things worth following up on**
1. Root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures is unknown — worth diagnosing before any redeploy of that version.
2. The orchestrator error that halted the rollout mid-way. A rollback that strands regions on the bad version is itself an availability risk, so it's flagged in the incident summary.

Roll back and create incident.
